AboutDescription: An unofficial, community-made mod launcher for Distant Worlds 2: manage Steam Workshop and local mods, load order, profiles and conflicts, run code mods, and publish your own mods to the Workshop. Open source under the MIT License.
AboutReleasesTooltip: Open the releases page in your browser to check for a newer version
AboutDisclaimer: This is an unofficial community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by CodeForce, Slitherine, or Matrix Games.
PublishNotLocalMod: Only a local Mod in the game's own Mod folder can be published this way - a Steam Workshop copy is already published.
PublishAboutToRunFirstTime: This publishes the Mod for the first time, by talking to Steam directly through your currently logged-in Steam client - no separate login needed. Make sure Steam is running before continuing.
PublishAboutToRunUpdate: This updates the Mod's existing Steam Workshop item, by talking to Steam directly through your currently logged-in Steam client - no separate login needed. Make sure Steam is running before continuing.
